_meta.indication: Treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC whose tumors have HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain (TKD) activating mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test, and who have received a prior systemic therapy

pivotal_trials.phase: First-in-human trial supporting accelerated approval; non-randomized single-arm design
pivotal_trials.design: Non-randomized, open-label, single-arm, multicenter, multi-cohort study; patients received HYRNUO 20 mg orally twice daily until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with previously treated locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC with HER2 (ERBB2) TKD activating mutations and ECOG PS 0 or 1; Group D was naive to HER2-targeted therapy, Group E had received prior HER2-targeted ADCs
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Confirmed objective response rate (ORR) and duration of response (DOR) as assessed by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR) using RECIST v1.1
pivotal_trials.n: 122 patients in the combined efficacy cohorts (70 in Group D, 52 in Group E)
pivotal_trials.result: Group D (N=70): ORR 71% (95% CI 59, 82), CR 2.9%, PR 69%; median DOR 9.2 months (95% CI 6.3, 15.0). Group E (N=52): ORR 38% (95% CI 25, 53), CR 6%, PR 33%; median DOR 7 months (95% CI 5.6, NE)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>20%): diarrhea, rash, paronychia, stomatitis, and nausea. Diarrhea occurred in 86% (Grade 3 in 15%). Serious adverse reactions occurred in 31% of patients, most commonly diarrhea (6%). ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 0.7%, ocular toxicity in 14%
target_moa: Sevabertinib is a small molecule kinase inhibitor of HER2 (ERBB2), including wild-type HER2 and HER2 activating mutations
companion_dx_detail: HER2 (ERBB2) TKD activating mutations detected by an FDA-approved test; tumor samples were retrospectively tested using Oncomine Dx Target Test (Life Technologies Corporation)

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because no significant efficacy or safety issues were identified during the review

surrogate_endpoint.text: Objective response rate (ORR) and duration of response (DOR)

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on objective response rate (ORR) and duration of response (DOR) [see Clinical Studies (14)]. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Complete the ongoing multicenter, randomized clinical trial Study SOHO-02, to verify and describe the clinical benefit of sevabertinib in adults with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC with HER2 (ERBB2) TKD activating mutations who have not received prior therapy for advanced disease (PMR 4933-1)

citations.quote: 4933-1 Complete the ongoing multicenter, randomized clinical trial, Study SOHO-02, intended to verify and describe the clinical benefit of sevabertinib in adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer whose tumors have HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations and who have not received prior therapy for advanced disease.

citations.quote: 4933-2 Conduct a hepatic impairment clinical trial to evaluate the serious potential risk of increased drug exposure and determine a safe and appropriate dosage of sevabertinib in patients with moderate hepatic impairment.

requirement.text: Conduct a clinical drug interaction study to evaluate the effect of sevabertinib on the pharmacokinetics of sensitive substrates of MATE1 and MATE2-K in healthy subjects (PMR 4933-3)

citations.quote: 4933-3 Conduct a clinical drug interaction study to evaluate the effect of sevabertinib on the pharmacokinetics of sensitive substrates of MATE1 and MATE2-K in healthy subjects to assess the magnitude of exposure change of these substrates and serious potential risk of increased drug toxicity and inform an appropriate drug interaction management strategy for coadministration of sevabertinib with these transporter substrates.
